description: This file defines the VideoDialog class for handling video embedding in the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, including dialog UI setup, video URL parsing, and node insertion.

classes.name: VideoDialog
classes.description: Class for managing video insertion dialog, parsing video URLs, and embedding videos into the editor.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the VideoDialog with the given editor context.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI for video input.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and removes the dialog from DOM.

methods.name: bindEnterKey
methods.description: Binds Enter key press to trigger video insertion.

methods.name: createVideoNode
methods.description: Creates an iframe or video element based on the provided URL, supporting multiple video providers.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the dialog, handles user input, and inserts the video node into the editor.

methods.name: showVideoDialog
methods.description: Displays the video URL input dialog and returns a promise resolving with the URL.
